questions.question: In John's vision, the first heaven and earth passed away. What did John see after that?

answers.text: A new heaven and a new earth
A wide desert under a dark sky
An empty sky over deep waters

questions.question: In John's vision, the One on the throne offers water from the spring of life freely. Who is it for?
In John's vision of the new Jerusalem, why did John see no temple in the city?

answers.text: The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple
The people worship outside its walls
The old temple stayed behind on the old earth

questions.question: In John's vision of the new Jerusalem, God's servants will see His face. True or false?
